summary: Google rank tracker with week-over-week changes (Apify)
description: Checks where your domain ranks in the Google top 100 for each keyword and shows the change since the previous run (up, down, entered, dropped out). Schedule it weekly. Data: Google SERP API Actor on Apify (pay per result, $0.03 per keyword for the top 100; needs any paid Apify plan). Disclosure: the Actor is built and sold by Rowfeed, the author of this flow.
